arxiv-2012-11853.description: Abstract We study momentum dependence of static magnetic susceptibility χ ⁡ ( q ) \chi(q) in paramagnetic phase of Heisenberg magnets and its relation to critical behavior within nonlinear sigma model (NLSM) at arbitrary dimension 2 < d < 4 2<d<4 .

arxiv-2101-08393.creator: Walker Ravina ∗ , Ethan Sterling, Olexiy Oryeshko, Nathan Bell, Honglei Zhuang, Xuanhui Wang, Yonghui Wu, Alexander Grushetsky
arxiv-2101-08393.description: Abstract . The goal of model distillation is to faithfully transfer teacher model knowledge to a model which is faster, more generalizable, more interpretable, or possesses other desirable characteristics. Human-readability is an important and desirable standard for machine-learned model interpretability. Readable models are transparent and can be reviewed, manipulated, and deployed like traditional source code.

arxiv-2205-05410.title: Fixed and Distributed Gene Expression Time Delays in Reaction-Diffusion Systems
arxiv-2205-05410.creator: Alec Sargood, Eamonn A. Gaffney, Andrew L. Krause
arxiv-2205-05410.description: Abstract Time delays, modelling the process of intracellular gene expression, have been shown to have important impacts on the dynamics of pattern formation in reaction-diffusion systems. In particular, past work has shown that such time delays can shrink the Turing space, thereby inhibiting patterns from forming across large ranges of parameters.

arxiv-2411-15278.title: Unitarity effects in high-energy elastic scattering
arxiv-2411-15278.creator: M. Maneyro, E. G. S. Luna, M. Peláez
arxiv-2411-15278.description: Abstract We investigate the high-energy behavior of the elastic scattering amplitude using the eikonal and U U -matrix unitarization schemes. arxiv-2412-06422.title: Universal 𝐂 ∗ \bm{{\mathrm{C}^{\ast}}} -algebras generated by doubly non-commuting isometries
arxiv-2412-06422.creator: Marcel de Jeu, Alexey Kuzmin, Paulo R. Pinto
arxiv-2412-06422.description: Abstract . We give an explicit injective representation of the universal C ∗ \mathrm{C}^{\ast} -algebra that is generated by doubly non-commuting isometries. This injectivity allows us to prove that such universal algebras embed naturally into each other and also, when combined with Rieffel’s theory of deformation, to show that they are nuclear and to compute their K-theory.

pmc-10514782.title: Quantitative Polymerase Chain Reaction System for Alongshan Virus Detection
pmc-10514782.creator: Alexander G Litov, Egor V Okhezin, Ivan S Kholodilov, Alexandra E Polienko, Galina G Karganova
pmc-10514782.description: The recently discovered Jingmenvirus group includes viruses with a segmented genome, RNA of a positive polarity, and several proteins with distant homology to the proteins of the members of the genus Orthoflavivirus. Some Jingmenvirus group members, namely the Alongshan virus (ALSV) and Jingmen tick virus, are reported to be tick-borne human pathogens that can cause a wide variety of symptoms.

pmc-10534263.title: Contemporary trends in anaphylaxis burden and healthcare utilisation in Western Australia: A linked data study
pmc-10534263.creator: Samantha L Stiles, Frank M Sanfilippo, Richard Loh, Maria Said, Rhonda M Clifford, Sandra M Salter
pmc-10534263.description: BackgroundAnaphylaxis is a growing public health problem in Australia. To determine the extent of the problem, we linked multiple health datasets to examine temporal trends in anaphylaxis events across the health system in Western Australia (WA).MethodsWe identified an anaphylaxis cohort from 1980 to 2020 using linked datasets from ambulance, emergency departments, hospital inpatients and deaths.

pmc-10571695.title: Cellular angiolipoma: a case report and review of the literature
pmc-10571695.creator: Zhen Zhang, Li-Jun Peng, Yu-Jun Tong
pmc-10571695.description: Cellular angiolipoma is a rare subtype of angiolipoma, with vascular density approaching 95%. This case report describes a 55-year-old female that presented for treatment of a mass in her left breast that had been tender to slightly painful on palpation for nearly 2 years The patient underwent surgical excision of the mass, which was pathologically confirmed as a cellular angiolipoma.

pmc-10661444.title: Perovskite-based photodetector for real-time and quantitative monitoring of sports motion
pmc-10661444.creator: Yuming Hu, Tingqing Wu, Jiabing Zhang, Wei Sun, Mengfei Lv, Hongfei Xie, Tangyue Xue, Teng Han, Chunbao Li, Meng Su, Yanlin Song
pmc-10661444.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). SummaryReliable monitoring the movement amplitude and dynamics during sports exercise is significant for improving training results and preventing training wound. Here, we present a printed perovskite-based photodetector for real-time and quantitative monitoring of sports motion. The ordered nucleation and growth of perovskite crystals are regulated by the 4-acetamidothiophenol (AMTP) at the interface, which promotes the size of perovskite crystals into the micrometer.

pmc-11562618.title: Familial Mediterranean Fever in Childhood
pmc-11562618.creator: Rabia Miray Kisla Ekinci, Elif Kilic Konte, Nergis Akay, Umit Gul
pmc-11562618.description: Familial Mediterranean fever (FMF) is the most prevalent monogenic autoinflammatory disorder, characterized by recurrent fever and serositis. It primarily affects individuals of Mediterranean descent, including Arabs, Armenians, Turks, and Jews. The Mediterranean fever (MEFV) gene, responsible for FMF, was discovered in 1997. Biallelic pathogenic variants lead to excessive activation of the pyrin inflammasome, resulting in inflammation.

We employed a Delphi consensus methodology to develop recommendations for the clinical management of BDET in cases of obstructive ETD.Methods.

pmc-11689054.title: MINDFULNESS-BASED COGNITIVE THERAPY STUDY FOR DEPRESSION AMONG KOREAN SPEAKING OLDER ADULTS
pmc-11689054.creator: Jenny Kim, Eun Jeong Lee, Amanda Shallcross, Seon Ah Ahn, Pallavi Visvanathan, Bohye Park, Hwa Young Chae, Linda Ko
pmc-11689054.description: Korean American (KA) older adults experience higher risk for depression compared to Non-Hispanic whites. Healthy Mind Healthy Living (HMHL) is a single arm, pre/post pilot intervention study to test and evaluate the effect of an abbreviated telephone-based mindfulness-based cognitive therapy (MBCT-brief) protocol to reduce depression and improve sleep quality and stress.

pmc-11690203.title: RESEARCH ADVANCES USING DIGITAL METHODS TO ASSESS COGNITION IN OLDER ADULTS
pmc-11690203.creator: Karysa Britton, Zoe Hawks, Martin Sliwinski
pmc-11690203.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This symposium highlights the use of digital methods to assess and contextualize cognition in older adults. Across five talks, we consider several digital cognitive assessment methods, including self-administered computerized tests and smartphone-based ecological momentary assessments (EMAs). Louisa Thompson reports findings on the utility and acceptability of using well-validated, reliable digital cognitive assessments to screen for cognitive decline among older adults in primary care settings.

pmc-12568800.title: Effects of flickering light stimulation on retinal blood flow and full-field electroretinogram in mice
pmc-12568800.creator: Milan Rai, Yamunadevi Lakshmanan, Kai Yip Choi, Henry Ho-lung Chan
pmc-12568800.description: PurposeTo investigate the effects of brief flickering light stimulation (FLS) on retinal electrophysiology and retinal blood flow (RBF) in normal C57BL6J mice.MethodsRBF and full-field electroretinography (ffERG) were measured before and after a 60 second FLS (12 Hz, 0.1 cd·s/m2) in a cohort of 8-12-weeks old C57BL6J mice (n=10) under anaesthetic and light-adapted conditions.

pmc-13262886.title: Comparing the uplink performance of 3D and 2D antenna models in THz networks in the presence of joint human and wall blockages
pmc-13262886.creator: Tahniyat Aslam, Irfan Ahmed, Sundus Ali
pmc-13262886.description: Terahertz (THz) communication is considered as a key technology enabler for realizing Sixth Generation (6G) network. THz band communication offers several promising advantages, but numerous challenges are expected due to the inherent limitations of propagation at THz frequencies in the 6G network, such as path loss, interference, human and wall blockages, etc.
